evidence: Skill procedure for check 25: 'every prompt opens http://localhost:3000 and directs the judge to the Playwright MCP tool'; defect is 'any prompt that could be satisfied by reading source, memory, or a first paint'. All five task prompts open with the same instruction on line 1: 'Evaluate the live Colderwater playground at http://localhost:3000 using Playwright MCP.' and all five judge.toml files declare the playwright MCP server (playwright-mcp, headless, isolated). Source: gates/render/prompt.md:1 'Use only rendered browser behavior'; gates/constraints/prompt.md:1 'Use only rendered browser behavior and the live DOM' and :5 'decide it from the listed DOM facts only, not from file names, bundled library names or how the code looks'; functional/prompt.md Action rules 'do not read implementation files to infer success'; polish/prompt.md Action rules 'do not read implementation files'; visual/prompt.md Action rules 'Do not read implementation files and do not infer behavior from styling'; functional, polish and visual also say 'never run shell or install commands'. Memory: functional and polish Evidence discipline 'A criterion passes only on evidence you gathered yourself in this session for that criterion. If you did not perform a step, that step did not pass'; visual 'Score from screenshots and the rendered page you observed yourself in this session'; constraints :5 'if a step could not be performed say so plainly and fail that criterion rather than assuming it passed'. First paint: the render gate criterion cw_workspace_loads_and_takes_typing requires clicking into the editor, typing a word with real keys, seeing it appear and reloading; the in-dimension gate in all three scored prompts requires 'that text typed into the code editor appears in it'; the visual prompt requires a ten-line draft, one Run, a click and a two-second caret watch, and a double-click selection before screenshots; both constraints criteria and every one of the 42 functional and 6 polish criteria prescribe real key, mouse, reload, multi-tab or restart-tool actions with a readback. I found no criterion decidable from a still first paint or from files. The task prompts are stricter than the frozen template on this row (the template gates and polish prompt carry no explicit no-source or real-input wording). Weak-app probe: a static shell with a picture of an editor fails the render gate and each in-dimension gate because typed text must appear; a canvas-drawn conforming editor is handled by app_context ('read colours and text from screenshots instead of computed styles'). Runtime evidence: no configured judge run exists on these bytes; the indexed hosted run is on an earlier candidate and I did not inspect its judge transcripts, so actual judge tool use on this candidate is unmeasured. That does not change this verdict because the row grades what the prompts direct.
